crop_box_units: source pixels [x0,y0,x1,y1]; a box may run past the image only where the ground is black (Nike)
note: Read by scripts/build-all-billboards.py (default order). Case pages may reuse source + crop_box as the case hero.

faces.why: The whole shoe, on its own black ground, reads as a sneaker in under a second. Its neon-green tongue tag is toned down (not removed) so it does not glow. The box runs past the image's left and right edges, filled black. A cut-off red swatch at the hero's right edge is blacked out first.

Carrier plane + spaceship silhouettes with contrails. The hero's rocket is a ~20px speck at board size. The engine-firing frame read as a dark wedge. The ship sits left of the diner mullion that hides the right third of this cabinet.

The starship itself, whole, on its dark floor. It is the Designer Alliance work. The Taycan + stormtroopers photo (zc_pull porsche/02.jpg) reads faster but is a different Porsche x Star Wars activation.
Hummingbird + red hibiscus: colour, one subject, survives the night grade. The sunglasses hero graded to a grey blank at Work scale. Wordmark, tagline and subscribe box fall outside the crop.

Vault of cash + MrBeast's face: the campaign in one frame. The baked GIVEAWAY headline is cropped off. The only image for this case. Council v2 still read it as front-lit, so it takes a steeper lamp falloff, lower exposure and extra softness.
Alita head-and-shoulders from the TE key visual, framed between the callout boxes. The other two Alita images are Facebook screenshots; this crop has no social-media chrome and no tiny callout text.

The Tradicional Cristalino label, close, on a dark ground of ice sparkle. The bottle-in-hand poster washed out to a pale smear once graded to the night. The other candidates carry baked headlines or Instagram chrome.
One face, round sunglasses, warm red rock: reads in a second and holds colour at night. The 'Let's Play' group shot turned into small grey figures at board size, even cropped tight.

faces.origin: Selsun Blue 'Dan Driff' film still (Zach Connolly site pull, 1920x1080)
faces.why: Dan Driff, white suit, wedging himself between the couple on the couch: the 'worst wingman' joke in one frame, at 3x the hero's resolution. The restaurant hero is darker and busier.

The SCOOBA LOVE title over the S-C-O-O column, large enough to read as an acrostic. The right-hand B-A-LOVE column is painted to the ground colour so no word is cut at the crop edge. The full layout left every criterion as unreadable small text.
